moments.title: Autumn is Here
moments.blurb: Meteorological autumn officially began on September 1st, marking the start of cooler weather, changing leaves, and cosy vibes across the UK.

angles.name: Autumnal vibes
angles.copy: Crisp mornings, pumpkin spice everything, and darker evenings. Meteorological autumn has officially arrived in the UK! What's your favourite thing about this season?

moments.title: Premier League Weekend Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Premier League weekend begins with Ipswich Town vs Liverpool tonight, followed by a packed Saturday and major clashes like Arsenal vs Chelsea on Sunday.

angles.name: Friday Night Football
angles.copy: Premier League weekend starts early! Ipswich Town host Liverpool tonight. Who are you backing for the first three points?

angles.name: Super Sunday Showdown
angles.copy: Big one on Sunday! Arsenal take on Chelsea in a massive Premier League London derby. Who's taking bragging rights?

moments.title: Roger Waters Turns 83
moments.blurb: Pink Floyd co-founder, bassist, and principal songwriter Roger Waters celebrates his 83rd birthday on September 6th.

angles.name: Prog Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to Roger Waters! The visionary behind so much of Pink Floyd's iconic sound. What's your favourite Waters-era track?

angles.name: 70s Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to Pink Floyd's Roger Waters! From 'The Dark Side of the Moon' to 'The Wall', his influence is undeniable.

moments.title: Macy Gray Turns 59
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American R&B and soul singer Macy Gray, known for her distinctive raspy voice and hit 'I Try', celebrates her 59th birthday on September 6th.

angles.name: Soulful Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 59th Birthday to the one and only Macy Gray! Still loving that unique voice and timeless hit 'I Try'.

angles.name: Queen of R&B
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 59th to Macy Gray! Her voice is instantly recognisable. What's your top Macy Gray tune?

moments.title: Gloria Gaynor Turns 83
moments.blurb: Disco and soul legend Gloria Gaynor, celebrated for her anthemic hit 'I Will Survive', marks her 83rd birthday on September 7th.

angles.name: Disco Queen
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Gloria Gaynor! Still surviving and thriving, what an absolute legend. What's your go-to 'I Will Survive' moment?

angles.name: Timeless Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a fabulous 83rd birthday to the incredible Gloria Gaynor! Her powerful vocals shaped an era and continue to inspire.

moments.title: Wiz Khalifa Turns 39
moments.blurb: American rapper, singer, and songwriter Wiz Khalifa, known for hits like 'Black and Yellow' and 'See You Again', celebrates his 39th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Rap Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 39th Birthday to Wiz Khalifa! From Pittsburgh to global charts, his tracks always hit. What's your favourite Wiz Khalifa song?

moments.title: Moby Turns 61
moments.blurb: Influential American musician, DJ, and animal rights activist Moby, whose electronic music defined the 90s and early 00s, celebrates his 61st birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Electronic Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Moby! His groundbreaking electronic tracks still sound fresh. Which Moby album is your favourite?

angles.name: 90s/00s Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 61st birthday to Moby! A true icon of the 90s and 00s dance scene. What's your favourite track from Play?

moments.title: Harry Connick Jr. Turns 59
moments.blurb: Grammy and Emmy-winning American singer, pianist, composer, and actor Harry Connick Jr. celebrates his 59th birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Smooth Jazz Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 59th Birthday to the effortlessly cool Harry Connick Jr.! His smooth vocals and piano skills are simply timeless. What's your favourite of his songs?

angles.name: Hollywood Crooner
angles.copy: Wishing a wonderful 59th birthday to Harry Connick Jr.! A true entertainer across music and film. What's your favourite performance?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Buzz Builds
moments.blurb: The new series of Strictly Come Dancing is set to launch on September 19th with a pre-recorded show, featuring new hosts and a rumoured Madonna tribute.

angles.name: Strictly's Return
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing is almost back on our screens with a new line-up of hosts and celebs. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Madonna Tribute Tease
angles.copy: Rumours are swirling about a huge Madonna tribute for the new Strictly series opener! What classic hits do you hope they dance to?
